scope: development-only sensor-aware DOFA-v2 scene representation selection on MARS physical-site folds 3 and 4
hypothesis: A wavelength-conditioned 105M-parameter Earth-observation ViT can capture target-reference change that is complementary to the current MARS U-Net plus Prithvi score, especially across the mixed Sentinel-2/Landsat contract.

research_basis.paper_claim_used: DOFA dynamically generates wavelength-conditioned patch embeddings and reports transfer to sensors unseen during multimodal pretraining
research_basis.important_limit: DOFA pretraining includes five EO modalities/sensors but not native Landsat; Landsat is an explicitly unseen-sensor transfer rather than a claimed pretrained domain
research_basis.dofa_v2_limit: the public v2 checkpoint postdates the cited DOFA paper and has no separate peer-reviewed architecture paper in the pinned sources

architecture.official_equivalence: four intermediate maps are bit-identical to official historical dofa_v2.py for a fixed six-channel tensor

radiometric_and_sensor_contract.upstream_mars_contract: full 16-channel MARS tensor is preserved; DOFA consumes only target/reference B02/B03/B04/NIR/SWIR1/SWIR2 subsets
radiometric_and_sensor_contract.physical_conversion: MARS spectral values are raw DN /5000; multiply by 0.5 to recover physical reflectance and by 255 for official DOFA byte-scale normalization
radiometric_and_sensor_contract.normalization: official DOFA Sentinel-2 means/std reordered to MARS blue, green, red, NIR, SWIR1, SWIR2; the same physical optical scale is used for Landsat
radiometric_and_sensor_contract.frame_order: reference and target encoded independently in chronological order
radiometric_and_sensor_contract.invalid_policy: target observable mask applied to both frames after normalization

extractor.feature_schema: final reference/target spatial means plus four-depth absolute-difference mean, signed-difference std, and signed max-absolute difference

selection_partition.crossfit: fit fold 3 and score fold 4; fit fold 4 and score fold 3

probe.normalization: fit and held folds use their own unlabeled per-feature moments before and after fixed random projection; held labels are excluded
probe.class_weight: sqrt(number of fit negatives / number of fit positives) for positives
selection_order: minimum fold AP delta versus current
minimum sensor AP delta versus current

promotion_gates.next_step_if_passed: freeze feature set, projection seed, C, and blend before one-shot fold-2 extraction

invariants: No fold-2, fold-0, fold-1, or paper-test outcome may affect folds-3/4 selection.
The current spatial-Prithvi score is the floor and zero blend reproduces it exactly.
Sentinel-2 and Landsat use distinct wavelength lists without changing the upstream 16-channel contract.
Bulk checkpoint, source clone, features, and model artifacts remain ignored; only compact protocols and reports are committed.
